description:
Enable the Excalidraw-based collaborative whiteboard feature in the Jitsi Meet Docker deployment. 

1. Modify the configuration at `/home/ga/jitsi/.env` to include `WHITEBOARD_ENABLED=true` and `WHITEBOARD_COLLAB_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL=https://wbd.meet.jitsi` (or any valid URL).
2. Restart the Jitsi web container to apply changes.
3. Open Firefox and join a meeting room named "WhiteboardGlossarySession".
4. Open the whiteboard (via the meeting toolbar) and write or draw "Glossary Terms" on it.
5. Create a file `/tmp/whiteboard_enabled.txt` containing the word "done" when finished.
